SAMSUNG TV

AirPlay

Send from an iPhone, iPad or Mac to a compatible Samsung TV.

  1. Connect your Apple device and Samsung TV to the same Wi-Fi.
  2. Open Control Center, then Screen Mirroring.
  3. Choose your Samsung TV. If a code appears on the TV, enter it on your Apple device.

TV not listed?

On Samsung, open Settings → General → Apple AirPlay Settings and check that AirPlay is on. Menu names may vary.

Casting goes directly to Samsung. The Mac remote relay does not need to stay awake for native AirPlay.
